description: An all-in-one China market data query service covering enterprise due diligence & risk assessment (registration, equity structure, financials, financing, litigation, penalties), stock/bond/fund data, regional economy & macro rates, news/sentiment & regulations, with multi-dimensional enterprise and bond screening.

display.description_en: An all-in-one China market data query service covering enterprise due diligence & risk assessment (registration, equity structure, financials, financing, litigation, penalties), stock/bond/fund data, regional economy & macro rates, news/sentiment & regulations, with multi-dimensional enterprise and bond screening.
